parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The parameter name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name can be up to 180 characters in length and cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.

parameters.name: ParameterVersion
parameters.description: The parameter version number. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: WithDecryption
parameters.description: Specifies whether to decrypt the parameter value. The value field in the response is populated only when this parameter is set to true. Otherwise, the value field is empty.
